# Public dataset evidence · API Probing - One Client Rejected on Many Distinct Paths

**No public dataset in the catalog exercises this detection yet.** No public dataset holds web or API access logs of credential probing against an API: the public web datasets checked (Splunk Attack Data nginx and Apache files) are single exploit requests, not a probing sequence, and the T1190 files in the catalog hold the exploited servers' process and file telemetry, not access logs. The lab run (red/web) is the evidence path.

It stays at its maturity level and waits for the lab run ([evidence plan](../../../docs/EVIDENCE_PLAN.md)).
